query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_entries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `identifiedChampions` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as identified_entries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(`aiConfidence` AS DECIMAL(5,2)) >= 0.70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_confidence
FROM `leaderboard_entries`;
